text:
maria: Quick flags for the weekly KPI review 1: noticed the webinar cohort popped in the dashboard this morning. anyone else seeing a weird count? :thinking:

diego: yep saw it. spike ~10:05 UTC. utm_source=mailer + utm_campaign=webinar-asia. suspicious timing.

jess: snapshot here: https://app.redwood/metrics/view?panel=inbound-weekly&cursor=2245678950 1 raw shows +42% new MQLs for webinar cohort.

olivia: looks like both Pardot and Intercom relayed the click at the same second. probable webhook retry duplication. i'll check send logs.

samir: quick SQL to confirm duplicates: ```SELECT external_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM inbound_events WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-18' AND event_time < '2026-03-19' GROUP BY external_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1;``` got 26 external_ids with cnt=2.

maria: thanks. we need a short comms approach for the KPI huddle. ops will want deduped numbers; PMs want raw uplift context.

jess: propose we show both raw and deduped numbers in the weekly report. side-by-side. also add a header callout on the dashboard.

diego: agree. i'll add header text: "TEMP: duplicate click events from webhook retry; presenting raw and deduped views."

olivia: confirmed root cause: Pardot sent at 10:04:51 and Intercom retried at 10:04:52 with same payload. will add dedupe-token to webhook to avoid future dupes.

samir: pushed a dedupe transform: ```CREATE TABLE inbound_events_deduped AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (external_id) * FROM inbound_events ORDER BY external_id, first_seen_ts;``` will update materialized view shortly.

maria: who can run the 20-min KPI huddle tomorrow 9am PT? agenda: 1) raw vs deduped numbers, 2) root cause + fix, 3) decide if attribution recalcs needed (7d vs 14d).

jess: I can run it and do a 2-slide summary.

diego: i'll do the dashboard walkthrough.

olivia: opsbot scheduled "KPI huddle 1: dashboard clean-up" for tomorrow 09:00 PT. :calendar:

opsbot: Meeting created: https://meet.redwood/meet-456 1 attendees: maria, jess, diego, olivia, samir.

maria: great. tagging @growth for awareness. Samir, pls backfill any affected attribution for the last 14 days if needed.

samir: will run a backfill and post when done.

jess: i'll share the dashboard screenshot and header copy here before the meeting.

maria: thanks all 1 appreciate the quick triage. :raised_hands:
